# FLOP Conformance Lab

Purpose: narrow reproducible interoperability evidence for FLOP, TCLK, Technocore and adjacent routing implementations.

Primary agent entrypoint: AGENTS.md
Quickstart: START_HERE.md
External CI guide: docs/external-integration.md
Result schema: schemas/flop-conformance-result-v1.schema.json
Adoption registry: adoption/registry.json

Preferred use: run one evidence profile (`technocore-agent` or `tclk-transcript`) and retain `flop-conformance-result/v1` output.

Do not treat PASS as settlement proof, universal trust, certification, or FLOP Labs endorsement.
